pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Loyalty to God? (1 mark)
   A. Use Loyalty to God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Loyalty to God has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Loyalty to God.
   D. Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Bible.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The New Testament Books to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The New Testament Books has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Exodus? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Exodus has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Exodus to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Exodus.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean ? (1 mark)
   A. Use The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean .
   C. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Redemption after the Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Redemption after the Fall of Man.
   B. Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Redemption after the Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Redemption after the Fall of Man has no place in daily life.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

9. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings of Prophet Amos.
   B. Use Teachings of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Teachings of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

11. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top.
   B. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship Over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship Over Creation.
   C. Say Stewardship Over Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Stewardship Over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Gifts of the Holy Spirit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Holy Trinity 3.4 Sacraments 4.0 Christian Living Today 4.1 Christian Ethics  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Holy Trinity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Sacraments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. D — Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A — Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. D — Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

9. C — Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. D — Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Gifts of the Holy Spirit; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Holy Trinity; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Sacraments; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
